name: middle-truncate
title: Middle truncate
description: Truncates in the middle so file names, hashes and URLs keep their ending, in pure CSS: quarterly-report-fin…2026.pdf, with the whole text for screen readers and the tooltip.
docs: Two spans, a start that truncates and an end that never shrinks, so there is no measuring. tail sets how many end characters stay; left out, a file keeps its extension and about five characters before it, moved to the start of the nearest word, so the end reads harbour.jpg and not rbour.jpg. In a table cell, give the table a fixed layout or the cell a max width, and in a flex row give the text min-w-0.
